sentences.text: 1 4.The learned Government Advocate(Crl.side) appearing for the first respondent opposes to allow this petition on the ground that it is a case of Section 376 IPC and the victim is a mentally disordered person.
5.This Court has considered the submissions made on either side.
6.The concurrence of a mentally disordered person cannot be taken as a ground to quash the charge sheet.
Therefore, this Court is not inclined to entertain this petition on this ground.
Accordingly, this criminal original petition is dismissed.
